# `CreateCalibFrame`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

State of the calibration-frame (bias/flat) creation worker.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, StartCreateCalib @0x3bc420, PrintMakeCalibStatus @0x3bcca0, CreateCalib @0x3bafa0, CreateCalibFunc @0x3bbb30, AppCreateCalibFunc @0x3bbe70 (64-bit build) |

Sent by the named CreateCalibFrame function started by StartCreateCalib. Function-state family (SendFuncEvent): state is always written; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms when the timer is started or the state is terminal; code and error at fail even when the stored code is 0 (cancel omits them); route optional. A null or nameless detail sends nothing, and non-working notifications can be suppressed while the function cache still changes, so a receiver cannot rely on seeing every transition. For custom calibration types 1-3 the status callback adds exp_us, adu and type on every formatted event; the automatic type clears that callback, so those members are then absent. The same callback members also appear in the function tree returned by iscope_get_app_state. Recipients: all retained 4700 sockets. No reply-before-event order is established: the RPC reply that starts the worker and the worker's events can arrive in either order. No fixed cadence. A negative requested exposure selects automatic exposure, and later events report the chosen value (READ). A frame whose mean is outside the requested ADU window ends the run with fail 204 (READ). Failure codes: 204, 238, 249, 300, 207, or a filter-wheel error (READ). No dedicated stop method exists; stop_func naming CreateCalibFrame ends the run with cancel, which carries no code or error on the wire (internal code 253, not sent); READ mechanism, INFERRED that a standalone run is reachable by name. iscope_stop_view cannot reach it. APK consumer expectation: a DTO declares state, lapse_ms, code and type.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver. The worker captures calibration frames and writes files.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"CreateCalibFrame"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Function-state name. idle is an initial/restored state and is not automatically sent; unknown internal codes fall back to idle. A formatter supporting a state does not mean every run visits it. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if non-empty stage string held | - | Only when a non-empty stage string is held. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if function producer: timer started (working) or terminal state | - | Elapsed milliseconds, independent of Timestamp. Working (or any state with a start and no end time, including complete) uses current monotonic minus start; other terminal states use end minus start. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail (function producer) | - | Function producer: present when state is fail, even if the stored code is 0. cancel omits it. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail (function producer) | - | Message for code; present with code. Lookup failure gives fail to operate. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | if optional; absent is a legitimate branch | - | Function-tree ancestry (for example View, Stack) built at send time. May be absent; not an address. [READ] |
| `exp_us` | integer | if custom calibration types 1-3 (callback installed); absent for the automatic type | - | Exposure in microseconds. When the request's exposure was negative, the automatically chosen exposure is written back, so later events show the chosen value. [READ] |
| `adu` | integer | if custom calibration types 1-3 (callback installed); absent for the automatic type | - | Integer mean raw pixel value (camera ADU) of the most recent frame; on the final event, the mean of the master frame. Checked against the requested ADU window (outside gives fail 204). [READ] |
| `type` | string | if custom calibration types 1-3 (callback installed); absent for the automatic type | - | Calibration frame type name: 1=bias, 2=flat_IR, 3=flat_LP, any other internal value unknown. The table is identical in the 32-bit build. One of: `bias`, `flat_IR`, `flat_LP`, `unknown`. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, working-flat - Custom flat capture (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"CreateCalibFrame","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","lapse_ms":5300,"exp_us":20000,"adu":1800,"type":"flat_LP"}
```

Event, complete-auto - Automatic type, no custom members (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"CreateCalibFrame","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","lapse_ms":64000}
```
